derived_fields.activity: Counts cutoff-safe semantic ownership event records by region and time window.
derived_fields.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison derived from official counters. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
derived_fields.report_deltas: Current counter minus the latest sampled counter at or before cutoff minus 2h, 6h, or 24h.
derived_fields.selected_metrics: Evidence citation records. Each metric_id names the region, source field, and transform; value and observed_at are frozen at prediction time.

limitations: The official War API does not expose live regional population or faction population.
Enlistment change is an activity proxy only and must not be described as population change.
Trend direction is unavailable until two complete adjacent sampled windows exist.

observed_fields.colonial_casualties: Official per-region counter of Colonial casualties suffered; unit is casualties.
observed_fields.day_of_war: Official in-game war day reported for the region.
observed_fields.ownership: Current strategic-base team at cutoff: WARDENS, COLONIALS, or NONE.
observed_fields.recent_events: Cutoff-safe ownership event records. A single direct flip may appear as a loss event plus a capture event.
observed_fields.total_enlistments: Official per-region enlistment counter. It is not concurrent population, unique players, or a faction split.
observed_fields.warden_casualties: Official per-region counter of Warden casualties suffered; unit is casualties.
